about:
EDL Packaging, a division of Massman Companies, is based in De Pere, Wisconsin. The company has over six decades of experience in the design and manufacture of secondary packaging equipment, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The company produces a range of shrink-wrapping and multi-packing machinery, including shrink wrappers, shrink bundlers, roll wrappers, automatic flight bar wrappers, forming shoe wrappers, tray formers, and loaders. It offers both standard and custom-engineered solutions, with specific machine models such as the SV342 wrap-around tray former, SV346 twin-stream flight bar, and SV348 double tight wrap servo system. The equipment is designed to bundle consumer and industrial products in low-density polyethylene film.

EDL serves industries including pet food, building materials, food, beverage, personal care, carpet and underlayment, grain, medical/pharmaceutical, and food service. Its customers are manufacturers of consumer and industrial products seeking end-of-line packaging automation.

EDL emphasizes safe, efficient, and high-quality machinery, with comprehensive designs that ensure quick installation, smooth startup, and system reliability. As part of Massman Companies, it can provide a single agreement for all machines needed on a production line, streamlining operations for customers.
